item.title: Crowds gather in Bellevue, WA in support of Iranian protests
item.description: Residents gathered in Bellevue on Saturday for a demonstration amid ongoing protests in Iran. Police in the area advise drivers to seek alternative routes due to traffic disruptions.

item.title: Chilly, wintry weather ahead for Seattle
item.description: As we head into the work week, temperatures stay on the cool side with highs in the mid 40s and overnight lows dipping into the upper 20s to low 30s.

item.title: Seattle weather: Cool sunshine Sunday afternoon
item.description: After a dry Sunday, our weather will quickly become cool and showery during the week with chances of wet snowflakes mixed in each day. Overnight lows will be frosty, near freezing every morning,

item.title: What's open, closed in Seattle on Presidents' Day 2026
item.description: Presidents' Day is on Monday, and the federal holiday brings with it both closures and special deals, like a free entrance day for national parks.

item.title: Will it snow in Seattle this week. Here’s what we know
item.description: After periods of extended near-record warm temperatures and sunshine streaks in the Seattle area, there are some increased chances of snow heading into the workweek.

item.title: Seattle weather: Tiny chance for wet snowflakes ahead
item.description: For late Presidents' Day morning, there could be a spotty rain-snow mix in the lowlands of western Washington. The chance for lower elevation snowflakes tomorrow is small for several reasons.

item.title: 2 people airlifted to hospital from sailboat explosion in Port Townsend, WA
item.description: Two people are in the hospital with burn injuries after a sailboat explosion in Port Townsend, Washington on Sunday caused them to evacuate the vessel on a dinghy.

item.title: Mom urges son's killer to come forward after Seattle shooting in Pioneer Square
item.description: Police in Seattle are still trying to identify four people who may have vital information about a deadly shooting in Pioneer Square that killed one man and left three others hurt.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks' Andrew Janocko joining Kubiak as Raiders offensive coordinator
item.description: A person familiar with the search said Raiders' Kubiak will bring Seahawks quarterbacks coach Andrew Janocko to be offensive coordinator.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks hiring Brian Fleury as offensive coordinator
item.description: The Seattle Seahawsk are hiring San Francisco 49ers tight ends coach/run game coordinator Brian Fleury as their new offensive coordinator, a source confirmed to FOX 13 Seattle.
